why: go-htmx4 #156: let WebKit (iOS, Safari) use WebTransport. Cloudflare's relays refuse the WebSocket fallback, so without it an iPhone never connects. WebKit's stalls (bugs.webkit.org 319818, moq-dev/moq#2388) cut long sessions, mostly when watching on an iPhone.
new: // go-htmx4 #156: the WebKit/iOS refusal is patched out (web/moq/npm-patches.json).

why: go-htmx4 #156: keep each camera frame's rotation (WebCodecs VideoFrame.rotation) with its size. iOS Safari hands over frames in the sensor's orientation with rotation set; @moq/publish dropped it, so a portrait iPhone broadcast arrived turned 90 degrees.
go-htmx4 #156: write that rotation into the catalog (hang's video.rotation, which @moq/watch already draws by) and give the display size upright.
